# Skillnet

> Source: https://www.cpaireland.ie
> Site: CPA Ireland
> Scraped: 2026-04-16

> Skillnet

#### •   CPA Ireland Skillnet will become Accounting & Finance Skillnet

This is a training network that is funded by Skillnet Ireland, a state funded, enterprise-led support body dedicated to the promotion and facilitation of training and up-skilling as key elements in sustaining Ireland's national competitiveness.

This network provides excellent value CPD (Continuing Professional Development) Courses in accountancy, law, tax and strategic personal development to accountants working both in practice and in industry. However, attendees are not limited to the accountancy field as all interested parties are welcome to attend events.

The Accounting and Finance Skillnet is funded by member companies and the Training Networks Programme, an initiative of Skillnet Ireland. funded from the National Training Fund through the Department of Education and Skills. The Skillnet Ireland Trainee Privacy Statement may be accessed on the Skillnet Ireland website here.
